patches.name: Always @handle · region · post time
patches.description: Shows the @handle, the region and the post time on feed videos and comments, including a video shared into a chat. Each surface and each part has a switch in Tweaks.

patches.name: Custom font
patches.description: Answers the factory every face TikTok draws with, so an imported font file replaces TikTok's own text on every surface. The switch and the picker are in Tweaks; off by default, and inert until a font is imported.
